context: Florrick confronts Wyll in the upper city after Ravengard’s death, arriving with magistrates and guards and opening the scene hostile (even spitting at Wyll). Off-screen, Lady Mizora has told Florrick that Wyll killed his father and seeks his power, which is why Florrick accuses Wyll of treachery. Florrick had previously trusted Wyll, so the accusation threatens both their relationship and the peace of the city; Wyll vehemently insists he tried to save his father and swears his honour. After a tense moment Florrick stands down and reveals Ravengard left a warning about the Absolute and a charge for Wyll to wake a wyrm beneath the city — a task Wyll vows to undertake.
